limitations: Interference check evaluates retained nominal B-reps at the current solved mechanical occurrence poses. It does not verify the supplier image or printed dimensions.
The assembly has no joints or motion studies. No native swept-motion result was requested or claimed in this validation.
Available CAD catalog has no automatic GD&T tolerance-stack validator. Existing tolerance bounds are separately derived acceptance calculations, not native CAD certification.

Export preflight ok:true means timeline/appearance readiness; its separate layout issues include below_bed/outside_bed/possible_overlap for the assembled CAD pose. Its overlap warnings use transformed mesh bounds, not exact solids.

Scene summary classifies cylindrical faces heuristically, leaves hole depth null and reports eight holes_overlap warnings. Adapter corner references are open R1 arcs, yet summary counts them as four diameter-2 holes; this is a hole-classification limitation, not an exact collision result.

The purchased reference omits shaft teeth/output shaft solid, internal threaded hole and cable boot. CAD cannot validate press-fit engagement, screw bottoming/thread engagement or boot fit for absent geometry.
Nominal geometry checks do not establish physical fit, printer capability, torque rating, creep or wear.
